description: Cast an I Ching hexagram using the traditional three-coin method (default) or the classical yarrow-stalk method, per James Legge's 1899 translation. Generates six line values (6/7/8/9) with the method’s real probabilities (coins: 1/8, 3/8, 3/8, 1/8 for 6/7/8/9; yarrow: 1/16, 5/16, 7/16, 3/16), builds the primary hexagram, lists any changing lines with their texts, and derives the resulting hexagram (null when nothing changes). Pass `seed` back to replay the exact same cast. The hexagram and line texts are traditional meanings for the calling agent to interpret in light of its own question — this tool does not answer the question itself.

examples.question: Should we ship the chance-pack family?

method.description: Divination method. "coins" (default): three-coin toss, six times. "yarrow": classical yarrow-stalk division, with different (narrower) probabilities.

question.description: Optional question being asked of the oracle. Echoed back verbatim in the result; never interpreted by this tool.

seed.description: Optional seed for a reproducible cast. Omit for real randomness; the seed used is always returned so the cast can be replayed.

name: cast_i_ching
